name: Str Replace Editor
description: Standard file system editor to view, create, and replace text in workspace files.
short_description: Workspace-scoped file editor for viewing, creating, and patching text files.
store_description: Built-in file editor that operates on files inside the active workspace only. Supports viewing file contents with optional line ranges, creating new files, applying exact string replacements, inserting text at a specific line, and undoing the most recent edit. Intended to be used after a workspace has been created (for example via source_control) so that every write targets a controlled, ephemeral working directory.

ar.short_description: Workspace-scoped file editor for viewing, creating, and patching text files.

examples.output_preview: The file src/app.py has been edited successfully.

usage_notes: Paths must be relative to the workspace root. 'str_replace' requires old_str to match exactly and to be unique in the file; expand the snippet if it is not unique. Use 'view' with view_range to inspect large files. A workspace must exist before any write (create_workspace in source_control is the typical prerequisite).

command.description: The file operation command: 'create' to make a new file, 'view' to read lines, 'str_replace' to modify text.

file_text.description: Content of the file to create (required when command is 'create').

old_str.description: Unique exact string snippet to replace (required when command is 'str_replace').

new_str.description: Replacement string snippet (optional for 'str_replace', defaults to empty).

insert_line.description: Line number after which new text is inserted (required for 'insert').

view_range.description: Line range [start, end] to view in target file.
